feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 October 2026 10:28pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 20 October 2026 at 10:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing, risk of gales for a time.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland and a shallow low over Ireland moving slowly northwards, bringing unsettled conditions and frontal systems across the area.


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 to 5, gradually veering west or northwest 5 to 7 during the morning tomorrow. Increasing 6 or 7, perhaps locally gale 8 in the afternoon. Decreasing 5 or 6 into the evening, then 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate by mid-morning tomorrow, then moderate or rough tomorrow afternoon. Falling mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain at first, soon becoming fair, further rain spreads from the west later in the night. Clearing to isolated showers later in the afternoon tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, decreasing southwest 3 or 4 around midday Thursday, then gradually backing southeast during the afternoon. Increasing east or southeast 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate soon falling slight overnight into Thursday, then slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain arriving later Thursday evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers and rain later on.
